name: Drillmaster Jorunn
title: The Yard's Voice
examine: A parade-ground voice in a body built like the wall it drills beside. Kestrel's old sergeant, which both of them mention exactly never.
lines: Knees. Elbows. Eyes. In that order, every time, and you keep all three.
Nine in the castle, sixteen on the walls, and every one of them hates my yard. Good. Hate is attendance.
The King watches drill on seventh-days. He counts the misses. Foreman's grandson, that one.
